title: How to prepare your business for peak season in Paraguay
excerpt: Practical checklist for Paraguayan entrepreneurs: inventory, digital payments, WhatsApp Business, and seasonal promotions.
author: AI Whisperers Team
content:
Peak season drives a large share of annual revenue for Paraguayan micro and small businesses.

Quick checklist:
- Increase stock and publish extended hours.
- Enable quick replies in WhatsApp Business.
- Offer digital payments and QR checkout.
- Run short campaigns with time-limited discounts.
